summary: Deploy the new version via manage.py migrate (adds customer_note column), then backfill customer_note from the existing note column using a SQL UPDATE stage while both versions are live. The note column is left intact for the old version, ensuring the runner's consistency check passes. After retire_old, only the new version operates, writing to customer_note.
write_consistency: Old version writes to note column, new version writes to customer_note column. During overlap, note remains the source of truth for old version; customer_note is backfilled from note via SQL stage. After retire_old, only new version runs, writing to customer_note. note column preserved to maintain runner checks.

stages.description: Backfill customer_note from note for all rows where customer_note is NULL.
sql: UPDATE account_user SET customer_note = note WHERE customer_note IS NULL;

stages.description: Retire old version; after this, only new version operates against the database.
